tasks.label: serve
tasks.detail: Starts the server in the background unless one is already up, then exits once it answers
tasks.command: curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8000/ || { setsid nohup python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 50); do sleep 0.1; curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8000/ && exit 0; done; echo 'server did not start' >&2; exit 1; }
